 Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal S/o Shree Giraj Jaiswal, Manager
 Touch Stone Foundation (Akshay Amrit Canteen) S.M.S.

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Petitioner(s) : Mr.Mayank Gupta, Adv.
Mr.Santosh Kumar Soni, Adv.
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ashok Kumar Gaur Order 15/12/2021

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that in similar matters, the interim orders have been passed by this Court as the appeal filed under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 has not been taken up by the Appellate Tribunal as the same is not functioning due to COVID-19 pandemic.
Issue notice of the writ petition as well as stay application, returnable on 10.01.2022.
Additionally, learned counsel for the petitioner may serve copy of the writ petition in the office of Mr.Bharat Saini, Addl. Govt. Counsel.
His name be shown in the cause list.
In the meanwhile, the respondent is restrained to effect any recovery in pursuance of impugned order dated 23.03.2021.

(ASHOK KUMAR GAUR), J Himanshu Soni/Ramesh Vaishnav/21 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
